title: experiment.planning_requested (v1)
description: ResearchOrchestrator instructs ExperimentPlannerAgent to plan a concrete experiment for the selected hypothesis, grounded in the frozen VerifierSpec, BenchmarkSpec, and ResearchSpec. ExperimentPlannerAgent itself is out of scope for this task (M8) -- this is the frozen contract only; no consumer wired yet.

hypothesis_bank_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen HypothesisBank object.

selected_hypothesis_id.description: ID (within the HypothesisBank) of the hypothesis to plan an experiment for.

verifier_spec_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen VerifierSpec object.

benchmark_spec_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen BenchmarkSpec object.

spec_interpretation_ref.description: Optional SpecInterpretation carrying a lightweight validation_study.

research_spec_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen ResearchSpec object.

method_ref.description: Confirmed method to plan on the benchmark mainline; null on hypothesis tracks.

baseline_result_ref.description: Optional frozen BaselineResult from the actual repository run; null before baseline reproduction.

plan_review_ref.description: The critique that rejected the immediately previous ExperimentPlan, present only on replanning.

research_memory_ref.description: Accumulated per-component/per-round memory used to plan the current ready DAG component.
